title: v0.8.5 - BREAKING CHANGES: security patches, bug fixes, accessibility improvements
body: UPDATE THE CLIENT IMMEDIATLY IF YOU'RE BELOW 0.8.5 VERSION! This release has really important fixes on security and older clients are NOT compatible with this new version, so you can't establish a connection between those! More info about that later. Also, this update includes adding the ability to adjust the font size and layout of the client. Use it in Accessibility -> Settings. Thanks!

title: v0.8.1 - Noise Suppression, Voice Chain Completion & Screen Share Quality
body:
Hey! This update includes some new additions like noise suppression and voice enhancement improvements, but also fixes lots of nasty bugs and even improves screen sharing. We patched WebRTC engine, so now it actually knows how to properly encode the stream for the selected quality. Plus some other additional stuff that you look [right here.](https://github.com/VitalikPro13/HOLLOW/blob/main/changelog.txt)

Alright, that's all I have, for now. Have a great day!

title: v0.8 - Offline Delivery, Custom Emotes, Conferences, Mobile Screen Share & Moderation
body:
Hello hello! Well, it's been 3 weeks since the last release, but this one is definitely worth it. We did lots of new stuff: custom emojis, Offline Delivery, conferences, saved messages, block/reports, moderation, profile showcase, mobile screen share+audio, links with invites, optimization; tons of fixes across multi-device, friends etc. Full detailed changelog for every version is [always here.](https://github.com/VitalikPro13/HOLLOW/blob/main/changelog.txt)

Please test the new features and write your feedback! I'll try my best to respond to everything. Take care!

title: v0.7.1 - Screen Share Audio on Mac, Accessibility & Data Channel Fixes
body: I realized that multi-device literally broke almost everything in terms of device ID mismatches, so that's why some stuff weren't working. Screen share audio should now work on both Windows and macOS! Other improvements include adding full Accessibility support (per [App Store Accessibility labels](https://developer.apple.com/help/app-store-connect/manage-app-accessibility/overview-of-accessibility-nutrition-labels/)) and WebRTC version upgrade for security with stability. You can read full details in the [changelog.](https://github.com/VitalikPro13/HOLLOW/releases/tag/v0.7.1-alpha) Thanks!

title: v0.7 - Multi-Device Fixes, Channel Encryption Hardening & Storage Manager
body:
Hey! Well, I guess that every single time a big feature is implemented, there will always be a bug that would just make you crash out. But it's fixed, multi-device support is now more stable and doesn't break your Friends or member rendering inside server chat.

What I need is definitely implement the proper inside-app changelog instead of listing features here... oh well, then I'll use all the full power of markdown, so just [press me here](https://github.com/VitalikPro13/HOLLOW/releases/tag/v0.7.0-alpha) and you will have the full list. You're welcome!

title: v0.6 - Multi-Device Sync, Code Signing & Push Notifications
body:
Hello! This was probably the hardest release in terms of scale. Absolutely MASSIVE amount of work and time put into making it convenient and without compromising privacy.

- First off, now you can sync between devices! Head to Security tab in Settings and find the section on device linking. If both devices are online, you both get data. If not, then nobody. Manual syncing on friends/servers is available.

- Windows builds are now officially signed! Always check that the files have valid signatures and only download from official website!

- Push Notifications for both Android/iOS. They're empty and just wake up the app in the background to securely fetch the messages. Apple/Google never see any data, not even ciphertext.

- Other improvements like new Help Center and fixes.

I'm really happy how everything turned out. Give as much feedback as you can and wait for more updates. Thanks!

title: v0.5 — macOS Release, Cross-Platform Auto-Updater & Mobile Port
body:
Hi! With a miracle, I got my hands on macOS and successfully packaged it with proper signing! Now it's freely available to download and auto-updater works without any issues. Mobile porting is also finished, Android is working great together with push notifications. Some of the new features:

- Temporary nicknames for friend requests (relay-scoped, ephemeral)

- Mic gain slider

- DM call voice activity animation

- Offline peer profile fetching

- Engine upgrade and encryption stability improvements

This was a massive amount of work, but we did it! I feel like that we need to add the syncing between mobile and desktop identities. Cool idea, but implementation would probably take a while. Don't worry, I'll think of something. Stay tuned and don't forget to write your feedback!

title: v0.4.2 — Identity Protection Patch
body:
Probably one of the funniest thing that happened to me. I got locked out of my own identity :D Yup, I'm definitely one of the greatest engineers of all time. Apparently the Windows DPAPI protection is vulnerable when you write it raw instead of the proper Credential Manager. Now it's fixed, but it teaches a good lesson once again - ALWAYS backup your passwords/phrases/data.

 I also redesigned the password protection too. You can protect the identity with a password instead of that OS one (+ optionally the client itself). Everything is in the Security tab in Settings. Have fun!

 P.S. This is unacceptable for production, but since we're in alpha - I can do it, but I definitely should be more careful next time with something like this. Will learn and do better!

title: v0.4.1 — Public Channels, Identity Protection + MORE!
body:
Hi! Shout out to [rambros3d](https://github.com/VitalikPro13/HOLLOW/issues/9) for suggesting about implementing the Public Channels! It's fully working, automatic, and allows to easily read server channels simply from the server ID or join link. You don't need to even create an identity! Works inside the app and in [web version.](https://hollow.anonlisten.com/)

 The app has kind-of native screen capturing (finally), identity at-rest protection against someone stealing your files (you can even set a password to lock your identity!), and as some always say: 'Bug fixes and improvements' Well, it's true, so thanks for reading!

title: v0.4.0 — Native Capture, Mobile Port & Optimization
body:
Hello there! It's been a little while since the last update, but what a ride... I was basically fighting for 3 days straight with Windows screen capture audio because the quality was an abysmal trash. I tried literally everything but only one of the most craziest ideas actually helped - literally using our own .exe recorder that captures the audio packets, sends them all encrypted using the WebRTC data channel, and use the same .exe to play them back. AND LATENCY IS STILL AT MINIMUM!

 I will experiment with it even more for the screen capture itself, but this is a BIG day for Windows users! Including me:) MacOS will come soon, I still want to do some other stuff and hopefully that I'll make it happen. Bug fixes, optimizations etc. etc. You got the point.

title: v0.3.1 — Performance (again)
body:
This was supposed to be the proper v0.3, but this version focuses more on the performance optimization on the UI side (what you feel as a user) and backend. Lots of fixes, the app should feel faster now because apparently there were lots of bad practices like constant rebuildings of the UI when not needed.

 I wanted to focus on new features, but like... if the app works like ****, then what's the point of those features, right? No worries, all lessons from optimizations are learned, so I won't repeat them again! New stuff coming soon. Thanks!

title: v0.3.0 — Performance & Quality Overhaul
body: Over 60+ fixes across the entire app... my goodness. In short, tons of bugs and scailability issues + performance problems. Well, not it's fixed! The app keeps getting better every day, all for you! Full changelog [here.](https://anonlisten.com/hollow/releases/030_QA.txt)

title: v0.2.0 — Roles, Mentions & More
body:
Hey everybody! We're back once again with some good updates. Roles were completely reworked with some additional fixes. Also, apparently I forgot to add 'Leave server' option... well, v0.1.0 won't be available cause it's breaking changes, so yeah.

 Like, I think that we can work this way. If there are breaking changes, then better update and remove the ability to downgrade, but if it's non-breaking - then no need to. Alright, enough of my yapping. Enjoy the update!

 Release notes:

- **Roles & permissions system** — Owner/Admin/Moderator/Member power roles, permission editing gated by tier, leave server, bans

- **Labels** — cosmetic labels with profile card badges, self-service picker, stable ordering

- **@Mentions** — inline mention highlighting with autocomplete, notification badge support

- **Invisible status** — appear offline while staying connected

- **Twitch profile sync** — Twitch badge on DM profiles, sync fix on both DMs/servers

title: Hollow is now in public alpha!
body:
I'm so happy, you just can't believe it! If you want to know all the features, then check out the main overview video of the project on my [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qsXc-hJizsQ)

 Full End-to-End Encryption everywhere, file sharing, DMs and servers (also, the ability to allow only your Twitch followers to join one!), simple built-in auto-updater, so you can be up-to-date with all the latest features.

 I would love to hear your feedback, so please write to feedback@anonlisten.com or simply post your comments on my [TwitterX](https://x.com/Anon_Listen). Have fun!
